description.narrative: Limiting the spread of the novel coronavirus, supporting the health sector and its resilience in confronting the coronavirus, and enhancing health services in combating the spread of the coronavirus.
Securing (500) thousand medical coats of all kinds (Medical Growns) to confront the new Corona virus, Covid-19.

The resilience and continuity of the health sector in providing therapeutic and preventive services from health workers and citizens, raising citizens' awareness on how to deal with the pandemic, taking precautionary measures to limit the spread of the coronavirus, and reducing deaths.
